# Variable `CCACHE_TOP_DIR`

### Yocto Project Reference Manual

When inheriting the ccache class, the CCACHE_TOP_DIR variable can be set to the location of where Ccache stores its cache files. This directory can be shared between builds.

Offline source: yocto-manuals/references/manuals/ref-manual/variables.md (online: https://docs.yoctoproject.org/scarthgap/ref-manual/variables.html#term-CCACHE_TOP_DIR)
